subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce the upcoming Annual Employee Appreciation Day event on Friday, May 28th. This year, we have planned various activities and surprises to celebrate all your hard work and dedication. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details in the coming weeks. We look forward to honoring each one of you and creating lasting memories together! Best regards, [Company Name]
